SELECT o.id AS id, o.task_no AS taskNo, o.title AS title, o.status AS status, o.initial_due_at AS initialDueAt, o.current_due_at AS currentDueAt, o.issuer_unit_name_snapshot AS issuerUnitNameSnapshot, o.created_at AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_branch b WHERE b.task_id = o.id AND b.status = 'OPEN' AND (o.issuer_unit_id = #{unitId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_assignment own WHERE own.branch_id = b.id AND own.to_unit_id = #{unitId}))) AS openBranchCount, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.to_unit_name_snapshot ORDER BY a.to_unit_name_snapshot SEPARATOR '、') FROM task_branch b JOIN task_assignment a ON a.id = b.current_assignment_id WHERE b.task_id = o.id AND b.status = 'OPEN' AND (o.issuer_unit_id = #{unitId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_assignment own WHERE own.branch_id = b.id AND own.to_unit_id = #{unitId}))) AS currentResponsibleUnits, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.status ORDER BY a.status SEPARATOR ',') FROM task_branch b JOIN task_assignment a ON a.id = b.current_assignment_id WHERE b.task_id = o.id AND a.to_unit_id = #{unitId} AND b.status = 'OPEN') AS myStatus, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_branch b JOIN task_transfer_request t ON t.branch_id = b.id WHERE b.task_id = o.id AND t.status IN ('AWAITING_TARGET', 'AWAITING_ISSUER') AND (t.target_unit_id = #{unitId} OR o.issuer_unit_id = #{unitId})) AS pendingTransferCount, (SELECT MAX(h.occurred_at) FROM task_action h WHERE h.task_id = o.id AND (o.issuer_unit_id = #{unitId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_assignment own WHERE own.branch_id = h.branch_id AND own.to_unit_id = #{unitId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_transfer_request t WHERE t.id = h.transfer_request_id AND t.target_unit_id = #{unitId} AND t.status IN ('AWAITING_TARGET', 'AWAITING_ISSUER')))) AS lastActionAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_branch b JOIN task_assignment a ON a.id = b.current_assignment_id WHERE b.task_id = o.id AND b.status = 'OPEN' AND a.due_at < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (o.issuer_unit_id = #{unitId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_assignment own WHERE own.branch_id = b.id AND own.to_unit_id = #{unitId}))) AS overdueBranchCount FROM task_order o WHERE ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_order (task_no, issuer_unit_id, issuer_unit_name_snapshot, issuer_user_id, title, instruction, expected_result, initial_due_at, current_due_at, source_result_id) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{issuerUnitId}, #{issuerUnitName}, #{issuerUserId}, #{title}, #{instruction}, #{expectedResult}, #{dueAt}, #{dueAt}, #{sourceResultId,jdbcType=BIGINT})

INSERT INTO task_branch (task_id, parent_branch_id, origin_from_unit_id, origin_to_unit_id, instruction_snapshot, expected_result_snapshot) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{parentBranchId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{fromUnitId}, #{toUnitId}, #{instruction}, #{expectedResult})

INSERT INTO task_assignment (branch_id, previous_assignment_id, from_unit_id, from_unit_name_snapshot, to_unit_id, to_unit_name_snapshot, source_action, due_at, status, accepted_by_user_id, accepted_at) VALUES (#{branchId}, #{previousId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{fromUnitId}, #{fromUnitName}, #{toUnitId}, #{toUnitName}, #{sourceAction}, #{dueAt}, #{status}, #{acceptedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{acceptedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.update: UPDATE task_branch SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{at}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN' AND version = #{version}
UPDATE task_order SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{at}, updated_at = #{at}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_transfer_request (branch_id, from_assignment_id, target_unit_id, reason, work_done, evidence_summary, remaining_work, requested_by_user_id, requested_at, status) VALUES (#{branchId}, #{assignmentId}, #{targetUnitId}, #{reason}, #{workDone}, #{evidence}, #{remaining}, #{userId}, #{at}, 'AWAITING_TARGET')
mapper.update: UPDATE task_transfer_request SET status = #{status}, target_responded_by_user_id = #{userId}, target_responded_at = #{at}, target_response_reason = #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, target_required_duration_minutes = #{minutes,jdbcType=INTEGER}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'AWAITING_TARGET' AND version = #{version}

UPDATE task_transfer_request SET status = #{status}, issuer_decided_by_user_id = #{userId}, issuer_decided_at = #{at}, issuer_decision_reason = #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, approved_due_at = #{dueAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'AWAITING_ISSUER' AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_result (branch_id, assignment_id, outcome_code, handling_detail, conclusion, suggested_unit_id, submitted_by_user_id, submitted_at) VALUES (#{branchId}, #{assignmentId}, #{outcome}, #{handling}, #{conclusion}, #{suggestedUnitId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{userId}, #{at})

INSERT INTO task_action (task_id, branch_id, assignment_id, transfer_request_id, action_code, actor_unit_id, actor_user_id, target_unit_id, old_due_at, new_due_at, note, occurred_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{branchId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{assignmentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{transferId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{action}, #{unitId}, #{userId}, #{targetUnitId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{oldDue,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{newDue,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{note,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{at})
INSERT IGNORE INTO task_command (actor_unit_id, action_code, idempotency_key, request_digest, task_id, branch_id, created_at) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{action}, #{key}, #{digest}, NULL, NULL, #{at})
